inj.note: Lewis will miss his second consecutive game due to a knee injury. He didn't practice at all this week, and it's unclear how long he's going to be sidelined. Fellow offensive guards Corey Bullock (quadriceps) and Torricelli Simpkins (ankle) are both questionable for Sunday, though they were both able to log full practice sessions Thursday and Friday.

news.h: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
news.d: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."
